recognize_zh: 骨髓腔完全被纖維化間質取代，內含大小不一的上皮細胞巢，部分巢中央細胞質嗜酸性明亮並呈同心圓排列（角化傾向），加上周邊造血細胞消失，符合轉移性鱗狀細胞癌。
features: Complete replacement of the intertrabecular marrow by desmoplastic fibrous stroma with scattered fat spaces
Variably sized nests of cohesive epithelial cells, some large with central dense eosinophilic cytoplasm and concentric (whorled) arrangement suggesting squamous differentiation/keratinization
Smaller nests and cords of basaloid-appearing cells with hyperchromatic nuclei
No residual hematopoietic cells in this field; adjacent thin bone trabecula
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows the intertrabecular space replaced by a desmoplastic fibrous stroma containing numerous infiltrating nests and cords of cohesive epithelial cells. Several larger nests show abundant dense eosinophilic cytoplasm with a whorled arrangement suggestive of squamous differentiation, while smaller nests are composed of cells with hyperchromatic nuclei. Normal hematopoietic elements are absent in this field. The findings are consistent with metastatic squamous cell carcinoma involving the bone marrow, in keeping with the known primary.

ddx.vs: Adenocarcinoma shows gland/lumen formation or mucin rather than squamous whorls with dense eosinophilic keratinizing cytoplasm, and is p40-negative.
Urothelial carcinoma may show squamous differentiation but is GATA3/uroplakin positive, and clinical history of a laryngeal/esophageal primary favors squamous carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Post-treatment marrow fibrosis with osteoblast clusters
ddx.vs: Reactive fibrosis contains bland osteoblasts along bone surfaces rather than infiltrative nests of atypical cytokeratin-positive cells.
